chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Sometimes I perform wudu (ablution), then the water runs out, so I call the servant-girl, but she delays bringing me the water, and my wudu (ablution) dries. He said: “Repeat it.”

key_terms.الْجَارِيَةَ: the servant-girl who was called to bring water

ai.seo_question: What should one do if the limbs dry during wudu because water was delayed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding continuity in wudu (ablution). If a person is interrupted and the previously washed parts dry before completion, the Imam عليه السلام instructs that the wudu (ablution) be repeated.
